title: lithocarpus tubulosus
intro: Lithocarpus tubulosus, commonly known as the Bur oak or Canyon live oak, is a species of evergreen tree native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its wood, bark, and leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries. The health benefits of Lithocarpus tubulosus include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant, due to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
